map.1: [Raptor]	Running. Waste of time, unless you're chasing after a monster.
map.2: [Thok]	Metal-man, races can be fun. Me and brother Marm would race to kill as many monsters as possible.
map.3: [Raptor]	That kind of race I can get behind.
map.11: [Troll]	Hur-hur, running good. Me look forward to running event.
map.12: [Thok]	Ha! Yes, my rocky friend, Thok thinks this will be good.
map.21: [Troll]	How do mermaids run when they have no legs?
map.23: [Troll]	Humans also run badly with no legs. That's why I eat legs first.
map.31: [Mr Mordaut]	It's a misconception that athletics is solely about strength and speed.
map.32: [Mr Mordaut]	It can be very tactical. The brain is just as important as the feet.
map.34: [Mr Mordaut]	So, use your mind to take advantage of your opponents.
map.41: [Mr Mordaut]	Some people compare running to a card game, with all the mind games and luck that entails.
map.42: [Thok]	Thok like card games. Snap is a big favourite after a glass of mead.
map.43: [Mr Mordaut]	I was thinking of a more intricate card game.
map.44: [Thok]	Snap with two packs of cards?
map.51: [Thok]	Welcome to the Games! I am Thok, champion of Daemonheim, drinker of mead, son of Daddy Thok...
map.52: [Mr Mordaut]	Deary me. People are here to watch the games, not hear about you.
map.53: [Mr Mordaut]	Welcome. My name is Mr. Mordaut and it is my honour to commentate on this event.
map.61: [Mr Mordaut]	Welcome, everyone. My name is Mr. Mordaut and my colleague here is known as ...um...zombie.
map.63: [Mr Mordaut]	Indeed, we really have a good turnout today.
